description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Thomson Reuters is hiring a Software Engineer to build systems and tools for creating, managing, and publishing content for its Regulatory Intelligence platform. The role contributes across the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, Agile collaboration, and production support.
Software engineer building internal web applications, REST services, JavaScript clients, and supporting production operations

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop and deliver components for internal applications
• Develop server based software with ReST web services which process XML returning XML and JSON
• Develop client application components using Javascript, JQuery and AJAX
• Work in an Agile, collaborative environment actively participating in all scrum ceremonies; Identify opportunities for improvement and offer new ideas to the team for improving our processes
• As a member of the operational support team provide rapid response and resolution to the business teams for production issues (May include off-hour support)
• Generate innovative approaches and solutions to technology challenges
• Promote development best practices and leverage TR and industry standard technology

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience with computer systems analysis and programming
• 1 – 2 years Java programming experience or coursework
• Experience with object-oriented design and development
• Experience with design and development of web based applications using ReSTful services, JSON, XML, Ajax, Javascript, CSS
• Working knowledge of XML parsing and processing
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Demonstrated ability to work and adapt well within a collaborative environment
• Self-motivated and self-directed
• Ability to plan and prioritize work effectively

Preferred:
• Experience using JEE, Spring Framework, and Dependency injection
• Experience with SOAP and WSDL Web Services
• Experience with XSLT
• Experience with Unit testing frameworks and technologies
• Familiarity with the Eclipse IDE
• Experience using OO and JEE design patterns
• Able to work with a team to meet a common goal
• Able to manage multiple priorities and deliver to commitment
